messages.source: 登录成功后回到本页，点击「我已登录，读取会话」。
messages.translation: After signing in, return to this page and click "I'm signed in — read session".

messages.source: 请用微信或雨豆APP 扫描二维码
messages.translation: Please scan the QR code with WeChat or the Yudou app

messages.source: 打开微信或雨豆APP 扫描二维码
messages.translation: Open WeChat or the Yudou app and scan the QR code

messages.source: {value} 已通过清华统一认证登录，已保存。
messages.translation: {value} signed in via Tsinghua Unified Authentication and saved.

messages.source: 在应用内打开雨课堂官方登录页，支持扫码或手机号+图形验证码+短信登录
messages.translation: Opens the official Rain Classroom sign-in page inside the app, supporting QR scan or phone number + captcha + SMS sign-in
Sign in on the official website

messages.source: 会话已失效（{value}）——可扫码重登，或导入其他设备导出的 Cookie。
messages.translation: Session expired ({value}). Scan to sign in again, or import cookies exported from another device.

Signed in to Tyche successfully and saved.

messages.source: 不勾选则只保存本次登录状态，失效后需手动重新登录。
messages.translation: If unchecked, only the current session is saved; you'll need to sign in manually after it expires.
Sign in with the method that suits you

messages.source: 粘贴后点击上方「保存」生效。
messages.translation: Paste, then click Save above to apply.

messages.translation: Sign-in state: unknown (network error at last check; not treated as expired)

messages.source: 导入其他已登录设备导出的登录状态文件，免扫码直接恢复登录
messages.translation: Import a sign-in state file exported from another signed-in device to restore sign-in without scanning

messages.source: 检查未成功：网络异常，登录状态未知
messages.translation: Check unsuccessful: network error, sign-in state unknown

messages.source: 雨课堂已开启图形验证码：请用微信扫码，或选「官方网页登录」。
messages.translation: Rain Classroom now requires a captcha: scan with WeChat, or choose "Sign in on the official website".

messages.source: 记住密码（登录状态失效后自动登录）
messages.translation: Remember password (auto sign-in after the session expires)

messages.source: 已导出到 {path}。⚠️ 该文件等同账号凭据：勿放同步盘 / 群聊 / 仓库，导入完成后请删除。
messages.translation: Exported to {path}. ⚠️ This file is equivalent to your account credentials: do not put it in a synced drive, group chat, or repository, and delete it after importing.

messages.limitHint: Keep concise; button/card label may wrap.

messages.source: 自动登录未成功{value}——可点「统一认证登录」重试。
messages.translation: Automatic sign-in did not succeed{value}. Click "Unified Authentication sign-in" to retry.

messages.source: 已导入雨课堂登录状态，正在刷新外部作业。
messages.translation: Rain Classroom sign-in state imported; refreshing external assignments.

messages.source: 未配置雨课堂登录状态——请先登录。
messages.translation: Rain Classroom sign-in state is not configured. Please sign in first.

messages.translation: Export is not supported in the browser preview; use the desktop app

messages.source: 雨课堂已启用图形验证码，直接短信登录暂不可用；请用微信或雨豆APP 扫码登录。
messages.translation: Rain Classroom now requires a captcha, so direct SMS sign-in is unavailable for now. Please scan with WeChat or the Yudou app.

messages.source: 确定退出{label}登录？将清除本机保存的{label2}凭据，不影响其他源。
messages.translation: Sign out of {label}? This clears the {label2} credentials saved on this device and does not affect other sources.
messages.limitHint: Keep concise; button/card label may wrap.
Keep concise; button/card label may wrap.

messages.source: 雨课堂扫码登录成功，已保存。
messages.translation: Rain Classroom QR sign-in succeeded and saved.

messages.source: 密码以密文存在本机，不上传、不进日志；退出登录即清除。
messages.translation: The password is stored encrypted on this device, never uploaded or written to logs, and cleared when you sign out.

messages.limitHint: Keep concise; button/card label may wrap.

messages.source: 会话已失效：作业页将拉不到雨课堂数据。可「一键重登（扫码）」，或在其他已登录设备「导出 Cookie」后在此「导入 Cookie」恢复。
messages.translation: Session expired: assignment pages will fail to fetch Rain Classroom data. Use "Re-sign in (QR scan)", or on another signed-in device choose "Export cookies" and then "Import cookies" here to restore.

messages.source: DSA OJ 登录成功，已保存。
messages.translation: DSA OJ sign-in succeeded and saved.

messages.source: 对所有源生效；已过期的作业仍显示。
messages.translation: Applies to all sources; overdue assignments are still shown.
